method: Independent semantic audit of all149previously open row contracts and saved evidence, followed by integration-controller clause/source-boundary review. Historical receipts remain unchanged.
decision: Accept A01 manifest definition/review, D06 provisioned-session-directory/1 Node mechanism, and S17 local-workspace-administration/1 SDK mechanism against their existing canonical acceptance clauses. Persistent accounts/teams, hosted services, physical providers and broader qualification are independent deliverables and are not claimed.

closures.acceptance: D06 — Implement private remote directories. Authorized users see only enrolled resources and allowed metadata; membership and resource access remain separate checks.
closures.basis: Actual Node mTLS directory and installed SDK resource caller enforce enrolled owner/device/generation, explicitly projected metadata, recipient visibility independent from resource grants, expiry/reconnect/leave/update/unpublish. Source plus peer tests remain byte-identical to the later saved 8 October proof. Persistent accounts, physical resource probes, browser client certificates and published Hub are not requirements in this literal implementation row.
closures.missingAcceptance: No literal private-directory mechanism gap found for the provisioned-session-directory/1 Node profile. Controller must decide whether that accepted bounded profile satisfies D06 or whether an already-authoritative release requirement demands an additional directory profile; cite that requirement if keeping it open. Do not silently import persistent-account or physical-network requirements. Current full candidate acceptance still belongs to integration.
closures.caveat: Hub/client is a source-bound Node provider, separate from packed SDK packages. This is mechanism acceptance only; it adds no support-row, physical or published-Hub claim.

clauseCoverage.finding: Only coordinator-constructed authority after native TLS/enrollment/principal/role/bearer checks; current identity/generation/expiry fences.
Reject non-enrolled owner, wrong device, stale generation and retiring currentness callback.
Projects only resource ID/revision/label and selected capability id/semantic/kind/schema; no arbitrary private metadata or authority.
Joining does not grant visibility; explicit host recipient allowlist remains separate from the installed runtime route grant.

Actual independently enrolled clients deny copied bearer/cross-session/forged owner/wrong device; recipient metadata update, unpublish, generation/reconnect/expiry/loss retire visibility. 8 October saved proof has 47 focused and 11 installed checks.

closures.remainingForController: Reconcile canonical evidence/checkbox and current exact-candidate gates; preserve old partial receipts and do not promote support.

closures.acceptance: S17 — Implement workspace/team administration. Create/manage membership, roles and resource-sharing policy with auditable changes; removal/revocation and delegated administration never bypass device-owner consent.
closures.basis: Public workspace API creates/manages member/delegated roles/sharing with bounded complete audit, explicit trusted-host actor authentication contract, exact approvals, independent source/sink owner consent, actual managed-route retirement on removal/revoke/expiry and late-work reservation. The receipt records 26 installed public checks and independent review; all four S17 implementation/test/caller/tool files still match its hashes. Literal row does not require persistent accounts, a distributed team database or physical devices.
closures.missingAcceptance: No literal membership/roles/audit/consent/revocation gap found for local-workspace-administration/1. Controller must accept that SDK profile or point to an authoritative requirement for durable/cross-process team administration. A cooperative host must authenticate actors and route through this controller; accepting the SDK mechanism does not claim a hosted account product. Historical installed proof and exact green gate custody have now been located and hash-verified; final current candidate gate policy remains separate.
closures.caveat: The stored receipt and SDK prose still explicitly label full S17 open. Treat this as an evidence-backed scope decision, never an automatic closure or a claim of durable/account administration.

clauseCoverage.finding: Explicit create/add/set/remove member API; immutable provisioned owner; actor is authenticated by trusted host exact-current approval.
Membership/policy/audit revisions commit atomically; full bounded audit refuses new changes rather than silently truncating.
Actual managed connections retire on member/policy/owner/expiry loss; fresh approval required and unresolved provider quota retained until settlement.
Independent source/sink owner approvals plus membership policy; copied approval/scope, self-promotion/owner removal/admin escalation rejected.

26 saved ordinary installed public SDK checks include genuine publisher/sink effect, both owner denials, revoke/removal/expiry/duplicate tuple and fresh recovery; not a network/account identity implementation.

closures.acceptance: A01 — Define connector/device-profile manifests. Identity filters, framing/decoder, resources, units, permissions, calibration, commands, safe-state and feedback levels are versioned and reviewed.
closures.basis: The row asks to define versioned reviewed manifests, not physically qualify a protocol device. The inert closed manifest explicitly includes identity filters, decoder ID/version/digest, framing, typed units/permissions, calibration, command safe-state and distinct feedback levels. Genuine packed Node RSS sample+command caller and independent review prove a first consumer. Physical protocol/equipment acceptance remains in A02-A16/Q08.
closures.missingAcceptance: No intrinsic field or review gap found in the literal row. Controller must reconcile the receipt's stronger physical-gateway condition with the canonical row, link exact source/test/commit evidence, and apply its final candidate gate policy before marking accepted. This audit does not itself close the checkbox.
closures.caveat: Current manifest/parser/example bytes equal the saved receipt. Downstream profile-connector implementation/test have changed; no claim is made that its entire old runtime qualification automatically covers current bytes.

clauseCoverage.finding: Closed field/equality declarations with duplicate/dangerous-name/nonfinite validation; not authentication.
Explicit decoder ID/version/SHA256 and bounded jsonl frame/chunk/count policies.
Bounded device descriptor capabilities retain value schema/units and per-direction permission restrictions.
Explicit revision/unit/error budget, same declared measurement unit, finite nonnegative bound.

Reliable exclusive invoke commands define deadlines, idempotency, safe-state and separate dispatched/target-acknowledged/observed/unverified feedback; observed state must match another declared resource.
Schema, manifest and decoder versions plus reviewed digest. Registry requires host trusted factory plus exact source digest, never manifest-controlled import.
Five parser tests cover exact fields, malformed/prototype/getter/limits/calibration/permissions/feedback; saved packed actual RSS caller verifies producer bytes and command/state feedback.
